'''Ziliss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|pureblooded]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Third Galactic War]], who functioned as an [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] enforcer.<ref name="Secrets" /> In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> she, along with fellow Imperials [[Dogah]] and [[Kodo (sergeant)|Kodo]], confronted [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]], [[Arn Peralun]], and [[Aryn Leneer]] when they arrived at the [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]] to investigate the whereabouts of [[Darth Malgus]]. However, Ziliss and her companions were slain in the encounter.<ref name="Secrets" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ziliss appears as a boss in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion. She is only seen in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] storyline, as she will be replaced by the Republic [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Meinar]] in the Imperial story.<ref name="Secrets" /> In the Republic storyline, Ziliss can only be saved if the player is a saboteur secretly supporting the Empire. If she is saved, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[NR-02]] will convey [[Darth Xarion]]'s thanks to the player, but mention that Ziliss still considers the player an "obnoxious, sanctimonious wart-hornet."<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=message|(None?)|ENCRYPTED}}</ref>
